column1: # Every rule ID on RULES.md before the B193 part 5 triage (main af7df6d6, 16 Nov 01:0x IST) and where it is now (P-188, P-611).
# kept = a row of RULES.md; merged = word for word in rules/merged-and-retired-2026-11-16.md, said by the named RULES.md row;
# retired = word for word in that side file, superseded or done (the rows named). Checked by tools/check-docs.sh (test: check-rule-triage.sh).
# line_sha = the first 16 hex of sha256 of the row's whole line as it was on RULES.md; a moved row must still hash to it.
